description: My interview with Arjun at Meta HQ was incredibly informative, here I am asking the questions we all want to know as advertisers. 🔥👌
transcript: Are there fundamental differences in strategy or setup you think advertisers should be implementing today because of the Meta Air Business Assistant that there wouldn't have been pre rolled out? I don't think so. I, I think the assistant is really grounded in Meta's best practices. Yeah. And I think like, everything that we've been saying publicly around, you know, creative and targeting and things like that, these are all sort of baked in as principles in the way that we develop the assistant. Right. And so I would think about this as a compliment to sort of the other intelligence that exists across public facing way that we, we talk about advertising and incrementality and things like that. I wouldn't change the way you advertise as a result of the assistant. I would use it as a way to sort of iterate and sort of build on your approach. So you're not gonna go into the assistant and say that you're doing X, Y and Z today. It's gonna say, toss it all out, you're doing it completely wrong. Like, here's how I think you should do it. It's more like, how do we sort of iterate together on an optimal solution that'll, that'll benefit you and, and grow your business?
